As a PAUSD teacher and mom, helping young people grow is what drives me. My family has deep roots in our local public schools, with one K-12 graduate and one current student. I’ve spent years creating programs, building community, and advocating for every child because that’s how we build strong schools.
I'm Linda Henigin,
and I'm running for Palo Alto School Board.
Learn More
As a PAUSD teacher and mom, helping young people grow is what drives me. My family has deep roots in our local public schools, with one K-12 graduate and one current student. I’ve spent years creating programs, building community, and advocating for every child because that’s how we build strong schools.
I'm Linda Henigin,
and I'm running for Palo Alto School Board.
Learn More
## Why I'm running
Our students deserve leaders
who make sure that, whatever the future holds, they are all ready to embrace it.
We deserve school board trustees
who invest in every single child in our schools.
Our community deserves leaders
who govern with our students at the center of their decisions.
#### Excellence for All
#### Strengthen Belonging
#### Rebuild Community Trust
##### This is how we can create a school system where together, we thrive.
## Candidate Forum Recordings
###### Watch recordings of the recent candidate forums to see where Linda stands on the issues facing PAUSD students, teachers, and local families.
##### League of Women Voters of Palo Alto/Palo Alto Council of PTAs School Board Candidate Forum
##### PTAC Secondary School Board Candidate Forum
##### PTAC Elementary School Board Candidate Forum
